description: Backend API routes for climate risk endpoints - 6 Express routes with asyncHandler pattern, input validation, error handling, and integration tests
steps: 1. Create backend/src/routes/climateRisk.ts: Import Router from express, asyncHandler from ../lib/asyncHandler.js, logger from ../lib/logger.js, all functions and types from ../lib/climateRisk.js. Export climateRiskRouter = Router().

2. In climateRisk.ts implement GET /assess/:meterId route using asyncHandler: validate meterId (non-empty, max 32 chars, regex /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/), call getMeterLocation(meterId), return 404 with 'Meter not registered in device inventory or location coordinates unavailable' if null, call assessMeterRisk(meterId, location), return JSON with meterId, location, scenario, overallRiskScore, breakdown (flood/heatwave/storm), insuranceTier, assessedAt, stale flag.

3. In climateRisk.ts implement GET /fleet route using asyncHandler: call assessFleetRisk(), return JSON FleetRiskSummary (totalMeters, riskDistribution, averageRiskScore, highRiskMeters, mitigationCoverage, assessedAt). Handle zero meters case (averageRiskScore and mitigationCoverage null).

4. In climateRisk.ts implement GET /scenarios/:meterId route using asyncHandler: validate meterId, call getScenarioBreakdown(meterId), return 404 if no assessments found, return JSON with meterId and scenarios array (scenario, projectionYear, overallRiskScore, breakdown).

5. In climateRisk.ts implement POST /refresh/:meterId route using asyncHandler: validate meterId, call getMeterLocation, return 404 if null, try refreshClimateData(meterId, location), return JSON {success: true, assessment}, catch errors and return 503 with 'Climate data unavailable, try again later'.
6. In climateRisk.ts implement GET /mitigation/:meterId route using asyncHandler: validate meterId, call getMitigationPlans(meterId), return JSON {meterId, plans: array of MitigationPlan objects}.

7. In climateRisk.ts implement PATCH /mitigation/:mitigationId route using asyncHandler: parse mitigationId as integer, validate status in request body is one of ['pending', 'planned', 'in_progress', 'completed'], return 400 if invalid, call updateMitigationStatus(mitigationId, status), return 404 if null, return updated MitigationPlan object.

8. Register climateRiskRouter in backend/src/index.ts: import { climateRiskRouter } from './routes/climateRisk.js', add app.use('/api/climate-risk', climateRiskRouter) after other route registrations (follow alphabetical order pattern).

9. Create backend/tests/climateRisk.integration.test.ts: Import vitest (describe, it, expect, beforeEach), import express app or create test server with climateRiskRouter, import functions from climateRisk.js and deviceRegistry.js. Test: register device with location, GET /assess/:meterId returns 200 with valid structure. Test: GET /fleet with zero devices returns empty summary. Test: PATCH /mitigation/:id updates status and returns updated object. Test: GET /assess/:meterId for unregistered meter returns 404. Test: POST /refresh/:meterId forces fresh assessment (check timestamp updated).
acceptance_criteria: All 6 routes implemented with asyncHandler pattern and input validation
Routes return correct HTTP status codes (200, 404, 400, 503) per design error handling section
Meter ID validation rejects invalid formats with 400 error
Routes registered in backend/src/index.ts and accessible at /api/climate-risk/* paths
Integration tests cover happy path, error cases (404, invalid input), and edge cases (zero meters)
All integration tests pass: cd backend && npm run test
verification: cd backend && npm run build - compiles without errors
cd backend && npm run test - all integration tests pass
Manually curl backend: curl http://localhost:3001/api/climate-risk/fleet (requires backend running) - returns JSON fleet summary
